name: Wallis and Futuna
prevalence_note: No territory-specific official scam notice was found; French national cyber-assistance guidance on fake administration and parcel messages is the only applicable official reference.
cross_border_note: Wallis and Futuna (+681) has few local numbers, so most unsolicited messages come from abroad, including mainland France (+33) and New Caledonia (+687).

scams.name: Faux message d'administration ou de colis
scams.name_en: Fake administration or parcel message asking for a fee or code in Wallis and Futuna
scams.signals_en: A message styled as an administration or carrier asks for a fee or code to release a parcel or settle a file.
scams.legit_en: National French guidance advises verifying on the official site and never paying via an unsolicited link.
bait_tactics: Demander quel service de Mata-Utu a envoyé le message
Dire que le bateau n'est pas arrivé et qu'aucun colis n'est attendu
